plugins.name: arangodb
plugins.description: Multi-model ArangoDB cockpit: databases, collections, document CRUD, AQL console, named-graph explorer, ArangoSearch views, analyzers, Foxx services, and cluster/shard health.

plugins.name: cassandra
plugins.description: Apache Cassandra cockpit with keyspaces, tables, materialized views, indexes, user-defined types, functions, CQL editor, and safety controls.

plugins.name: chroma
plugins.description: Chroma vector database cockpit: tenants, databases, collections, record CRUD, similarity search, embedding projection, and distance-space comparison.

plugins.name: clickhouse
plugins.description: ClickHouse cockpit with databases, tables, views, dictionaries, mutations, merges, processes, users, SQL editor, DDL helpers, and safety controls.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare cockpit for accounts, zones, DNS, cache purge, tunnels, WAF/rulesets, page rules, certificates, Workers routes, settings, and API exploration.

plugins.name: cockroachdb
plugins.description: CockroachDB cockpit with databases, schemas, table data, ranges, nodes, jobs, sessions, queries, SQL editor, DDL helpers, and safety controls.

plugins.name: consul
plugins.description: HashiCorp Consul cockpit: hierarchical KV browsing and editing, catalog services and nodes, health checks, sessions, prepared queries, service-mesh intentions, and ACL tokens, policies, and roles.

plugins.name: couchbase
plugins.description: Couchbase Server cockpit: buckets, scopes and collections, JSON documents, SQL++ with an index advisor, live cluster and DCP metrics, a data map, and XDCR activity.

plugins.name: couchdb
plugins.description: Apache CouchDB cockpit: databases, document CRUD with revision and conflict tooling, Mango queries, map/reduce views, replication and the live changes feed.

plugins.name: duckdb
plugins.description: Query local Parquet/CSV/JSON files with DuckDB, entirely in the browser. Files are never uploaded.

plugins.name: dynamodb
plugins.description: DynamoDB cockpit with tables, indexes, items, backups, TTL, tags, PartiQL, and guarded item/table operations.

plugins.name: elasticsearch
plugins.description: Elasticsearch cockpit with cluster health, indices, mappings, settings, shards, documents, JSON DSL search, and document/index operations.

plugins.name: etcd
plugins.description: etcd v3 browser with a namespaced key tree, typed value editing, leases, cluster members, RBAC users and roles, a live watch stream, and maintenance.

plugins.name: influxdb
plugins.description: InfluxDB cockpit for v3, v2, and v1 time-series APIs with database/bucket browsing, measurements, schema, data preview, queries, and line protocol writes.

plugins.name: jaeger
plugins.description: Jaeger tracing cockpit with services, operations, trace search, and trace detail inspection.

plugins.name: kafka
plugins.description: Kafka cluster browser with brokers, topics, partitions, recent messages, consumer groups, offsets, and producers.

plugins.name: loki
plugins.description: Loki log cockpit with labels, label values, streams, LogQL range queries, and build/status details.

plugins.name: memcached
plugins.description: Memcached workspace with an LRU key browser, live cache metrics, a slab allocation map, segmented-LRU and connection statistics, a watcher activity feed, and an audited command console.

plugins.name: milvus
plugins.description: Milvus vector database cockpit: collections, partitions, schema design, similarity search, embedding projection, index builds and RBAC.

plugins.name: minio
plugins.description: File browser for MinIO and MinIO-compatible buckets.

plugins.name: mqtt
plugins.description: MQTT broker client with live subscriptions, publishing, retained-message browsing, a topic tree, $SYS metrics, and EMQX management tables.

plugins.name: mssql
plugins.description: SQL Server cockpit with databases, schemas, table data, views, procedures, users, jobs, T-SQL editor, DDL helpers, and safety controls.

plugins.name: nats
plugins.description: NATS and JetStream browser with server info, streams, consumers, stored messages, and publishing.

plugins.name: neo4j
plugins.description: Neo4j graph cockpit with databases, labels, relationship types, graph visualization, schema, Cypher editor, and guarded graph mutations.

plugins.name: nfs
plugins.description: File browser for NFSv3 exports.

plugins.name: nomad
plugins.description: HashiCorp Nomad workload orchestrator: jobs, allocations, clients, deployments, live logs, and exec.

plugins.name: notebook
plugins.description: Agent-hosted Docker sandbox running JupyterLab through a connection-scoped web proxy.

plugins.name: opensearch
plugins.description: OpenSearch cockpit with cluster health, indices, mappings, settings, shards, documents, JSON DSL search, and OpenSearch-compatible index operations.

plugins.name: oracle
plugins.description: Oracle cockpit with schemas, tables, views, procedures, packages, sequences, users, tablespaces, sessions, SQL editor, DDL helpers, and safety controls.

plugins.name: pinecone
plugins.description: Pinecone cockpit: serverless and pod indexes, index configuration and stats, namespaces, vector browsing and CRUD, metadata-filtered similarity search, and backup collections.

plugins.name: prometheus
plugins.description: Prometheus cockpit with PromQL query, targets, alerts, rules, labels, metric metadata, series, status, live overview metrics, and gated admin operations.

plugins.name: pulsar
plugins.description: Pulsar browser for tenants, namespaces, topics, subscriptions, producers, consumers, schemas, message browsing, live tailing, and publishing.

plugins.name: qdrant
plugins.description: Qdrant vector database cockpit with collections, collection details, point browsing, payload inspection, and JSON vector queries.

plugins.name: rabbitmq
plugins.description: RabbitMQ management for queues, exchanges, bindings, consumers, message inspection, and publishing.

plugins.name: scylladb
plugins.description: ScyllaDB cockpit: keyspaces and tables, editable CQL grids, a CQL console, a live token-ring and shard-per-core topology map, per-table compaction/cache/latency metrics, nodetool-style cluster status, and a CQL tracing viewer.

plugins.name: snowflake
plugins.description: Snowflake cockpit with databases, schemas, tables, views, warehouses, roles, grants, users, stages, pipes, tasks, streams, query history, credit metrics, and a SQL editor.

plugins.name: solr
plugins.description: Apache Solr cockpit with cores, documents, schema fields, JSON queries, config, ping, commit, optimize, and CoreAdmin operations.

plugins.name: sqlite
plugins.description: Open and query local SQLite database files entirely in the browser — the file is never uploaded.

plugins.name: surrealdb
plugins.description: Explore, query, and manage a SurrealDB namespace/database.

plugins.name: telnet
plugins.description: Legacy Telnet terminal access.

plugins.name: trino
plugins.description: Trino cockpit with catalogs, schemas, tables and views, bounded data grids, SQL editor with live query stats, cluster nodes, running queries with kill, and session properties.

plugins.name: typesense
plugins.description: Typesense cockpit with collections, schemas, documents, search, aliases, synonyms, overrides, keys, metrics, and stats.

plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: Vault browser for secret engines, KV v1 and v2 secrets with versions and metadata, auth methods, policies, tokens, leases, namespaces, and audit devices.

plugins.name: vscode
plugins.description: Agent-hosted Docker sandbox running code-server through a connection-scoped web proxy.

plugins.name: weaviate
plugins.description: Weaviate cockpit: collection schema, object CRUD, GraphQL and vector/hybrid search, cross-reference graphs, embedding projection, shards, tenants, and backups.
